Was kostet mich die Gegenstimme?: What will the counter-voice cost me?
Die Rufbindung hinter der Schallschleuse: Break the call binding behind the sound lock.
„Eine alte Lok, neue Arbeit und lebende: “An old locomotive, new work and living feet in the lime,” says Whistle. “That's already more than a ghost.” He pins your transcripts to the case wall next to his stove.
Pfiff heftet eure Abschriften an die Fal: Whistle pins your transcripts to the case wall. Nothing moves on until you are ready; the night train has no hidden clock.
Pfiff schließt die Schallschleuse hinter: Whistle shuts the sound lock behind you. The sentence from the train grows quieter and breaks off. “Your name is yours again,” he says. “Don't give it away again just because a voice sounds familiar.”
Pfiff stellt den Becher ab. „Jede Nacht: Whistle sets down his mug. “Every night a black shift train runs through the abandoned yard. It stops at stations that haven't existed for seventy years, and people get on who come back in the morning with lime on their boots.” He slides a ticket across the table. Old paper, a fresh stamp, and your name on the front. “That was lying in the ticket window this morning. The window has no tickets left. I don't think it has anything to do with your Starling. But it is your ticket.”
Later. I have other things to do.
„Dann fang am Endbahnhof an“, sagt Pfiff: “Then start at the terminus,” says Whistle. “Nellie at the ticket window, the depot, the Workers' Arch. I'm happy to listen when you come back. And no hurry: the train waits for answers, not for the clock.”
Whistle refills all three chambers for free. Behind the sound lock, no personal call can reach you any more.
Der Weg zu Sequenz 4 kann über eine selb:
The way to Sequence 4 can lead through an answer you create yourself, not through owning someone else's voice.

You write Hedda Quist's name next to the note. Formulas, ingredients and trials remain an investigation of their own; the night train demands none of them.
Du schreibst Hedda Quists Namen neben de: You write Hedda Quist's name next to the note. Formulas, ingredients and trials remain an investigation of their own; the night train demands none of them.
Zum ersten Mal gehst du am Endbahnhof vo: For the first time you walk past the terminus without the ticket window rattling. The gorge does not pull you back bodily; that was never the agreement. Nellie confirms the system is switched off. Your name tablet lies unchanged among your things. Wherever you go, Dunscar can wait for your return without putting new people in your place in the meantime.
